name: Bexar County, TX
findings: Bexar County has 4,469 nonprofit organizations. 1,764 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,416 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bexar County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Bexar County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 100 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 395 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 395 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
